title: Headline typeface
slide_intent: Teach designers to select a display face by the voice a headline should carry. Weight and case can give a short phrase force at first read.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can sustain its direct voice with Quasimoda Heavy across headlines, with an available system alternative for office documents.
demonstration: White and pink uppercase words in Quasimoda Heavy make a large specimen against black. The page specifies uppercase use and identifies Arial Black as the fallback.
practical_value: Use uppercase Quasimoda Heavy for a headline, or Arial Black in a system-font document.

content_islands.name: Face and fallback
content_islands.spec: Set the introduction and the system-font alternative at left in light text. Show the substitute’s name in its own weight.

content_islands.name: Headline specimen
content_islands.spec: On black, set the face name in white and the descriptive phrase in pink. Keep the specimen large and tightly stacked.

content_islands.name: Character set
content_islands.spec: Place the uppercase alphabet and numerals below the specimen, with the note about uppercase use close to the letters.
